Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the family relationships and consumption rules (treated the grandma’s brother’s daughter—an adult—as a “second cousin” who doesn’t eat carbs instead of her three kids) and misread the average potato weight as 0.25 lb instead of the stated 0.5 lb. These errors led to underestimating total pounds and incorrectly concluding 1 bag instead of the correct 2.
